verdict.rationale: Fern's own docs describe Fern Editor, which lets content writers, PMs and marketers update documentation without code, markdown, or Git. That covers the core non-technical editing need. The pack does not say whether those edits sync back to the same repository or source of truth the technical writer uses. Fern Agent's repository access is a separate feature and is not credited here. Missing for 10: evidence that editor changes flow into the shared git/source repo (e.g., via commits or PRs), details of the visual web editing interface, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a technical writer, non-technical teammates can edit docs in a visual web editor without touching git, and their changes flow into the same source of truth

citations.quote: Fern Editor lets team members such as content writers, product managers, and marketers update documentation without code, markdown, or Git.
